messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: control-plane 5xx spike detected across auth and org-lookup (region: us-east-1). Error rate ~18% 5xx over last 2m. Paging on-call: @eve_oncall

maria.nguyen: I'm on it. seeing a lot of gateway 502/504s hitting /v1/orgs/lookup. Also increased timeouts to billing service.

cheng.li: logs show org-lookup returning 500 with stacktrace pointing to config fetch path: `ConfigService.getOrgConfig` NPE-ish. Could be a rollout of the config cache layer.

samir: echoing that. Traffic graphs: CPU on controlplane-config nodes normal, but threadpools are saturated, latency to redis for config-cache is spiking (p95 > 400ms).

eve_oncall: quick customer impact check: product_eng, any high-priority customers affected?

product_eng: Confirmed a handful of PLG startups in us-east seeing failed logins and bot flows. Severity: P1 for user-facing auth failures. No billing charging failures yet but timeouts might cause degraded telemetry.

maria.nguyen: immediate mitigation idea: flip controlplane routing to bypass config-cache for org-lookup (fall back to direct DB read). That should reduce redis dependency. Can we apply a runtime flag?

cheng.li: yes, there's a dynamic feature flag `use_config_cache` per-service. We can set it false for controlplane-org-lookup service via the runtime manager. I'll apply now.

cheng.li: applied `use_config_cache=false` to service=controlplane-org-lookup in us-east-1. Deploy confirms accepted.

incident-bot: Action recorded by changelog-bot: runtime flag change `use_config_cache=false` by cheng.li at 3698765487.

samir: after flip, 5xx dropped from 18% -> 6% in 45s. Latency to redis decreased in other paths. Org-lookup success rate improving.

eve_oncall: good. still seeing some 502s upstream at the gateway for auth service. Could be lingering in-flight requests or a separate issue.

kyle_ops: I'm going to throttle retries at the gateway for a short window to prevent cascading. Patching envoy config: set max_retries=1 for controlplane routes and lower connection pool to reduce surge. Applying now.

kyle_ops: envoy patch applied via rollout manager to gateway cluster us-east-1.

product_eng: asking CS to message impacted customers: soft outage for logins and embeds in us-east. ETA for full mitigation?

maria.nguyen: estimating 10-15m for full stabilization once in-flight backlog clears. We should check billing path after that.

cheng.li: diving deeper into the config-cache code — I see a recent change that avoided null-checks when refreshing cache entries; under a certain race the service throws a NPE during refresh which bubbles as 500. We'll open a hotfix PR.

samir: can we temporarily scale controlplane-config pods by +3 to speed refreshes and reduce race windows?

maria.nguyen: do it. k8s scale +3 for deployment/controlplane-config in us-east-1.

incident-bot: k8s-bot: scaled deployment/controlplane-config +3 replicas (from 4 -> 7) in us-east-1 by samir.

kyle_ops: watching gateway errors — 502s down to 2% now, org-lookup success ~98%.

eve_oncall: good progress. next steps: 1) prod hotfix for null-check, 2) revert runtime flag once hotfix is deployed and validated, 3) post-incident RCA with rollout notes. Assign owners?

cheng.li: I'll own the hotfix PR and patch. Target CI -> canary -> us-east roll deploy in 20m.

maria.nguyen: I'll coordinate rollback of `use_config_cache` once canary is green.

samir: I'll take monitoring and rolling scale back down after stabilization.

product_eng: outreach: sending a short note to affected accounts now, ask for status updates after 30m.

eve_oncall: if anything regresses, escalate to SRE lead @kyle_ops and call on-call phone.

incident-bot: Summary: runtime flag flipped to bypass cache, scaled config service, gateway retry limits reduced. Partial mitigation achieved (5xx -> ~2%). Hotfix PR in flight. Paging resolved for now but monitoring remains. Thread closed after stabilization unless status changes.

maria.nguyen: After canary, hotfix merged and rolled to us-east at 3698765900. Re-enabled `use_config_cache=true` for org-lookup; monitoring shows stable 5xx ~0.4% and p95 latency back to baseline.

cheng.li: putting final notes into the incident tracker: root cause = race condition during config-cache refresh introduced in recent rollback-optimized change; contributing factor = synchronous dependency on redis causing amplification under burst. Remediation: add null-check + safe-refresh, add circuit-breaker and fallback to DB path, add canary gate in deploys for cache changes, alert rule tuned to split config-cache vs org-lookup errors.

eve_oncall: thanks team. I'll file a postmortem and schedule a blameless review. Leaving this thread open for any followups. :white_check_mark:
